objectives.statement: Recognize and form the Norwegian -s genitive for people and definite nouns.
Use the til-construction with the owned noun in the definite form.
Choose between the -s genitive and the til-construction in simple sentences.
Use an apostrophe after names ending in s, z, or x.

notes: Must contrast s-genitive with til-construction; owned noun is indefinite after -s but definite before til; include apostrophe after names ending in s/z/x.
